title: HTTP API Contract
description: Optional REST envelope and routing discipline. Configure in project.invariants.yaml → api, network, routing.

rules.message: res.json() without envelope success key — may break API contract.
rules.remediation: Wrap responses per project.invariants.yaml api.envelope. Disable rule if project has no envelope convention.

rules.message: Common dev port — may conflict with project canonical port.
rules.remediation: Use network.canonical_port from project.invariants.yaml or env var. Customize forbidden_ports list.

rules.message: Dynamic route — ensure static routes registered before param routes if routing.static_before_dynamic is true.
rules.remediation: Register static paths before /:id handlers (Express, similar frameworks).
